title: 第25章 我会罩着你的第26章 路见不平拔盖相助
slug: 人在美利坚我的叔叔堂吉诃德
content_zh:
“约会？哈！”堂吉诃德嗤笑一声，“我可不会再在女人的身上花心思了，小子。”
“今天是你的大日子，”他紧接着说道，“我要带你去一个地方，见一个人。”
“谁？”
“我的一个同学兼前同事，他欠我一个大人情。”
李维虽然有些不太明白，为什么堂吉诃德会把自己也带上去见他这个同学。但是既然他决定这么做了，肯定有他的深意，便没有提出任何的反对意见。
从布鲁克林一路出来，越朝城中心开，周边的高楼大厦越来越多、道路越来越窄，李维突然感觉到周围的声音越来越吵闹。
曼哈顿就是真正意义上的钢铁丛林，楼与楼之间的间距、车与车之间的距离都很窄，但是动辄一百层楼以上的擎天巨柱遮天蔽日，让人声和车辆的声音、穿堂风的声音在墙壁之间回响、增强，最终形成了一种无处不在的噪音。
穿过了汹涌的人潮和车流，最终，破丰田停在了曼哈顿中城公园大道的一栋摩天大楼面前。
“摩根大通？”李维有些惊讶地抬头望着眼前的钢铁巨兽，“你同学混的不错嘛。”
“这里听起来光鲜，但是实际上也就那样吧，”堂吉诃德深吸了一口气，对着后视镜最后一次整理了一下那套有些旧的西装，“不过他混的不错，据说已经做到摩根大通的合伙人了。”
他从后座中拿出了一个精巧的黑色包装袋，上面印着万宝龙的loo。
两人下了车，混进了周围穿着定制西装、行色匆匆的精英们，走进了摩根大通总部的大堂。
前台那位妆容精致的接待小姐看到李维的脸之后，眼神微微一亮，随后她又把视线往下，打量了一下李维的穿着，顿时眼神中流露出一股失望的神色。
“你好！”堂吉诃德敲了敲台面，瓮声瓮气地说道，“我来找朱利安·瓦格纳。”
前台接待小姐不舍地把视线抽回来，换上了一副职业性的甜美笑容。
“请问您有预约吗？”
“没有，”堂吉诃德摇了摇头，“你告诉他堂吉诃德·塞万提斯来访，他应该会见我的。”
几分钟之后，他们被带到了48层。
空气中弥漫着一种混合了咖啡香气、古龙水和金钱的混合味道，夕阳的阳光透过巨大的落地窗，把脚下的中央公园染成了一股金色，衬得这块儿纽约市中心的绿色宝石像是金融巨擘脚下的一块儿小小地毯。
在一间宽敞得有些过分的办公室里，李维见到了那位朱利安。

他看上去比堂吉诃德要小10岁以上，穿着一件剪裁完美的深蓝色西装，头发梳得一丝不苟，虽然已经中年，但是保养得极好。
“上帝啊！”朱利安从办公桌后走出来，目光在堂吉诃德身上停留了几秒，“真的是你？我们有多少年没见了？10年？还是9年？”
“12年了，朱利安，”堂吉诃德说道，“对了......这是我给你带的礼物。”
朱利安接过堂吉诃德递过来的袋子，拆开来一看，是一支做工精巧的万宝龙钢笔。
“谢了，堂，”他把钢笔随手插进了办公桌的笔筒里，里面已经插满了各色镶金镶钻的其他款式的钢笔，“快坐吧，喝点儿什么？我前段时间从佳士得拍回来一套收藏级别的麦卡伦单一麦芽威士忌......”
“不用了，”堂吉诃德摆了摆手，“你看我现在这个样子，喝麦卡伦简直就是浪费。”
content_en:
"A date? Ha!" Don Quixote sneered, "I won't spend any more time on women, boy."
"Today is your big day," he said immediately, "I want to take you to a place and meet someone."
"Who?"
"A classmate and former colleague of mine, he owes me a big favor."
Although Levi didn't quite understand why Don Quixote would bring him up to meet his classmate. But since he decided to do this, he must have deep intentions, so he did not raise any objections.
All the way out of Brooklyn, toward the center of the city, there were more and more high-rise buildings and the roads became narrower. Levi suddenly felt that the sounds around him were getting louder and louder.
Manhattan is a true steel jungle. The distance between buildings and cars is very narrow. However, the sky is blocked by giant pillars that are often more than 100 stories high, allowing the sound of human voices, vehicles, and drafts to reverberate and intensify between the walls, eventually forming a kind of ubiquitous noise.
After passing through the turbulent crowds and traffic, the broken Toyota finally stopped in front of a skyscraper on Park Avenue in midtown Manhattan.
"JP Morgan Chase?" Levi looked up at the steel beast in front of him in surprise, "Your classmate is doing well."
"This place sounds glamorous, but in reality it's just like that," Don Quixote took a deep breath and adjusted his somewhat old suit for the last time in the rearview mirror, "But he's doing well and is said to have become a partner of JPMorgan Chase."
He took out a delicate black bag from the back seat with the Montblanc logo printed on it.
The two got out of the car, blended in with the hurried elites wearing custom-made suits, and walked into the lobby of JPMorgan Chase's headquarters.
When the receptionist with exquisite make-up at the front desk saw Li Wei's face, her eyes lit up slightly. Then she looked down again and took a look at Li Wei's clothes. There was a look of disappointment in her eyes.
"Hello!" Don Quixote knocked on the table and said angrily, "I'm here to see Julian Wagner."
The receptionist at the front desk reluctantly withdrew her gaze and put on a sweet, professional smile.
"Do you have an appointment?"
"No," Don Quixote shook his head, "tell him that Don Quixote Cervantes is coming and that he should meet me."
A few minutes later, they were taken to the 48th floor.
The air is filled with a mixed smell of coffee aroma, cologne and money. The setting sun shines through the huge floor-to-ceiling windows, dyeing the Central Park below into a golden color, making this green gem in the center of New York look like a small carpet under the feet of financial giants.
In an office that was too spacious, Levi met Julian.
He looked more than 10 years younger than Don Quixote. He wore a perfectly tailored dark blue suit and his hair was meticulously combed. Although he was middle-aged, he was extremely well maintained.
"Oh God!" Julian came out from behind the desk and his eyes stayed on Don Quixote for a few seconds. "Is it really you? How many years have we not seen each other? 10 years? Or 9 years?"
"Twelve years, Julian," Don Quixote said, "By the way...this is the gift I brought you."
Julian took the bag handed over by Don Quixote and opened it to see that it was an exquisitely crafted Montblanc pen.
"Thank you, Don." He casually inserted the pen into the pen holder on his desk, which was already filled with other styles of pens inlaid with gold and diamonds. "Sit down, have something to drink? I bought a collection of Macallan single malt whiskey from Christie's some time ago..."
"No need," Don Quixote waved his hand, "Look at me now, drinking Macallan is just too much.It's just a waste. "
